task: Evaluate 14 saved raw-history Garman-Klass volatility models on their full eligible 2019-2025 test dates without retraining

findings.evidence: The full evaluation log stops at MLP-20 with KeyError 'CBIO' from score_neural's scale_by_ticker lookup. load_raw_neural selects tickers by raw pre-2016 row count but builds history only from valid pre-2016 rows; an eligible test ticker can therefore lack a finite positive training-history MASE scale. No CSV or PNG was produced.
findings.fix: Define and report an explicit scoring policy for test windows whose ticker lacks a valid pre-2016 MASE scale. Apply the same eligible observation set to all model rows sharing a window, quantify excluded observations and tickers, and verify row counts against that policy. Do not synthesize a scale from test data.

findings.evidence: statistical_predictions('har'/'har_80') computes np.cumsum(group.Variance) across every row. raw_frame leaves invalid source rows with NaN RawVariance, and load_raw_neural carries that NaN into Variance. One invalid row makes all later cumulative values NaN, including eligible test windows after the gap.
findings.fix: Compute HAR lag means from each eligible target's finite preceding input window, or use a cumulative array with invalid rows replaced by a neutral value while retaining the eligibility gate. Check a fixture with a gap followed by an eligible window.

findings.evidence: statistical_predictions('sarima') replaces invalid rows with NaN and passes the array to SARIMA()._model; models/sarima.py::_model rejects every nonfinite history before statsmodels can filter it. The cohort contains invalid source rows, so this row will fail on an affected ticker.
findings.fix: Use a causal missing-observation filter that accepts NaNs, or split at gaps and forecast from each valid segment. Add a gap fixture and preserve one-step alignment.

findings.evidence: The only focused fixture has two tickers with 24 entirely valid rows and calls HAR/RFSV but not score_neural or SARIMA. It cannot detect the missing training-history scale or either invalid-row path. The production run failed before the first model row, so the 14-row artifact requirement has no successful end-to-end check.
findings.fix: Extend the smallest fixture to cover a ticker without a scale and an invalid row before later eligible windows, then rerun the full evaluator and inspect all 14 rows and saved outputs.
